messages:
maria: Quick check — onboarding AcmeCorp private VPC tomorrow. They asked where to put Prom/Graf/OTLP endpoints and what ports/certs to open. Do we have a short checklist + dashboard links I can share? cc @lee @andrew
lee: Short checklist to share (TL;DR):
  1) Prometheus: either remote_write to our ingest endpoint OR allow our scraper via peering/privatelink.
  2) Grafana: share read-only dashboards (snapshot/embed) or add their Grafana as a data source.
  3) Logs/traces: OTLP -> otlp.redwood.internal:4317 (gRPC) or HTTP/OTLP 4318; recommend otel-collector.
  4) Firewall: egress to the endpoints + mTLS cert exchange if requested.
  5) Alerts: apply per-customer alert overrides (see console).
  Full runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/private-vpc-observability :point_right:

sara: For quick copy/paste — sample Prometheus remote_write config we give customers (put in prometheus.yml):
```yaml
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
remote_write:
  - url: "https://push.redwood-internal/api/v1/remote_write"
    bearer_token: "${PUSH_TOKEN}"
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem
      insecure_skip_verify: false
```
(They should store PUSH_TOKEN in their secrets manager and allow egress to push.redwood-internal:443)

andrew: For alert tuning — call out these defaults we recommend to reduce noise: cpu/utilization > 90% for 5m, request_error_rate > 5% for 10m, and a paging rule only after 3 consecutive evals. Where do we surface these to customers?
lee: We expose per-customer overrides in Console -> Private Deployments -> <customer> -> Alerts. Default templates are in git: https://github.com/redwood/alert-templates (PRs welcome). We can also add silences for maintenance windows via the console API.

maria: Grafana link I can paste for them?
lee: Use this dashboard for onboarding: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/acme-onprem/overview?orgId=1 — if they don't have org access, create a snapshot (Share -> Snapshot) and send that, or import the dashboard JSON from https://go.redwood/dashboards/onprem-overview.json

sara: Also sending a minimal OTEL collector config snippet for logs/traces (they can run collector as sidecar or centrally):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
exporters:
  otlp/redwood:
    endpoint: "otlp.redwood.internal:4317"
    tls:
      insecure: false
    headers:
      x-customer-id: "ACMECORP"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/redwood]
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/redwood]
```
Note: recommend mTLS if they require extra isolation; coordinate certs with us.

andrew: Firewall note: they must allow egress to otlp.redwood.internal:4317 (gRPC) and push.redwood-internal:443. If they're using VPC NAT, add those to allowlist.
lee: Also check SELinux/iptables inside their appliances if they run private Prometheus. Common issue: Prometheus can't reach push endpoint due to proxy env not set (HTTP_PROXY).

infra-bot: Created support ticket SR-8743 and assigned to lee for cert exchange and onboarding checklist.

maria: Perfect — I'll send this over and schedule a 30m handshake with Acme infra. I'll ping in here once we have the time. :thumbsup:
lee: :thumbsup: happy to join the call.
